\section[(dialogue)]{Words from chapters 193-195 — a first pass}

\label{lesson:FR-R198-first-pass-words-from-chapters-193-195}



\begin{quote}
Say the words for a coin and a banknote.
\end{quote}

\subsection*{Your turn}
Say these aloud:

\begin{itemize}
\raggedright
  \item a sheet, a drawer, an armchair, a saucepan, a frying pan
  \item a valley, temperature, a butterfly, a fly, a mosquito
  \item a dialect, a piece of news, advertising, a screen, a keyboard
\end{itemize}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A sheet? (\textbf{le drap}.) A drawer? (\textbf{le tiroir}.) An armchair? (\textbf{le fauteuil}.) A saucepan? (\textbf{la casserole}.) A frying pan? (\textbf{la poêle}.) A valley? (\textbf{la vallée}.) Temperature? (\textbf{la température}.) A butterfly? (\textbf{le papillon}.) A fly? (\textbf{la mouche}.) A mosquito? (\textbf{le moustique}.) A dialect? (\textbf{le dialecte}.) A piece of news? (\textbf{la nouvelle}.) Advertising? (\textbf{la publicité}.) A screen? (\textbf{l'écran}.) A keyboard? (\textbf{le clavier}.)
\end{tcolorbox}

\begin{tcolorbox}[breakable,colback=teal!4,colframe=teal!35!black,title={Before you move on}]
A butcher? (\textbf{le boucher}.) A mechanic? (\textbf{le mécanicien}.) An electrician? (\textbf{l'électricien}.) A plumber? (\textbf{le plombier}.) A worker? (\textbf{l'ouvrier}.) A bridegroom? (\textbf{le marié}.) A bride? (\textbf{la mariée}.) A widower? (\textbf{le veuf}.) Success? (\textbf{le succès}.) Failure? (\textbf{l'échec}.) A promise? (\textbf{la promesse}.) A discount? (\textbf{la réduction}.) The sales? (\textbf{les soldes}.) A coin? (\textbf{la pièce}.) A banknote? (\textbf{le billet de banque}.)
\end{tcolorbox}
